notes.title: Melee Weapons Added: Welcome the Katana and the Spade
notes.content:
Now you can use the katana and the spade to block attack from enemies. Press down the trigger or the grip button or space (PC mode), it’ll reduce the damage you bear. Block has a cold down time, take care of the block tempo. 

Remember the spade not only can be used as a melee weapon, you can use it to take some plants home and grow them in your green house.

notes.title: Merry Christmas, we’ve prepared Christmas gifts for everyone
notes.content:
Firstly, during the Christmas period, besides 30% discount, everyone who purchase will receive a key from us, you can send it to your friends as a Christmas gift too. Please remember to contact us by email: faerysword1@gmail.com

Secondly, we greatly updated our game:
1, PC mode (None-VR) added. If you’re tired with a VR device, you can take it off and play our game on PC directly.

2, UI control optimized. Now you can interact with UI by your hands, instead of the “look at style”.

3, Tutorial added. It takes you only a few minutes to get started.

4, New creeps added, spider fighter and spider archer. They can easily be taken down one by one, but they’re a team.

5, Enhanced fight performance. Besides exposing blind side to player (relate to player’s perception value), creep will get a critical hurt if you hit their vital part. Especially when you hit creep’s eyes when in sneaking status (the sneaking status lasting time relate to player’s hide value), the damage is pretty awesome.

6, Bullet time added, it happens every time the fight begin or when you hurt badly. It’s an excellent time to hit creeps’ vital part and blind sides, and the reloading speed is much quicker too.

7, Readjust weapons parameters, now they have better sense of gun. If you feel your gun is not steady enough, you can try firing in bursts or hold down your gun and keep firing.

8, Optimized creeps’ AI. Creeps are now more agile, if their legs get crippled, they’ll slow down and have lower attack value. Besides that they may go crazy if they hurt badly.

9, Some creeps can attack at a wide range now, hit their missiles before they hit you. 

Finally hope you like this game and other new features will be added soon.

notes.title: We Cut Down the Price
notes.content:
It’s our first time to release a game on Steam. Sorry for our lack of experience, but we have been always listening to the players' recommendations. And from feedbacks, we decide to cut down the price, because it’s a little expensive for an Early Access. 

Sorry to let this happen. If you bought our game already, we're really sorry. As compensation, if you love our game we can send you keys to share with your friends; and if you feel annoyed, refunding is OK.

notes.title: Big Update – the game is not that hard now
notes.content:
1. Add difficulty option. You can enjoy the game in the easy mode now. If you think you’re prepared, you can challenge the hardcore mode.

2. Add some graphic option. Now Anti-Aliasing is a choice.

3. Adjust the balance of the game. Take care of the guns, they’re more dangerous now.

notes.title: This is an Early Access game !
notes.content:
Though we spend nearly two years on this game , it's still an Early Access . We will provide updates to make our game better. 
  However there must be some mistakes , after we release it we found out it's not . We're contacting Valve presently , and we're really sorry to let that happened.
